text: Trustee

For the past 12 years, it has been my honor to serve the Cambrian community on the Board of Trustees. As a parent, neighbor, and longtime advocate for our schools, I care deeply about ensuring every student has the support, opportunities, and resources they need to thrive.

My service extends beyond our local board because Cambrian's voice must be heard wherever public education decisions are made. Through the Santa Clara County School Boards Association, its Legislative Action Committee, the California School Boards Association, and the County Committee on School District Organization, I have brought Cambrian's priorities directly to county, state, and elected government leaders.

Education funding can be unpredictable, especially in a district that is funded on enrollment. Since we have seen enrollment declines which negatively impact our funding. I have worked to create stable revenue sources through Extended Day Programs, better use of district facilities, and land development agreements that continue to support staff and students.

On the Board, I have served as Board President, on bond oversight, and contributed to policy work. My focus remains strong schools, thoughtful governance, responsible budgets, and support for students' academic, social, and emotional needs.

text: Retired Educator

I am proud to be a candidate for the Cambrian School District Board of Trustees. With more than 30 years of experience in education, I have served as a teacher, site administrator, district administrator, and county office administrator. I also opened a brand-new school as its founding principal, gaining strong experience in budgeting, personnel, curriculum, and operations. These roles have given me a deep understanding of how schools function and how effective leadership supports student success.

In addition to my professional background, I bring the perspective of a parent. My two children attended Cambrian schools, and my family has experienced firsthand the value of a strong public education and a supportive school community.

I am committed to ensuring that every student has access to high-quality learning opportunities, safe and inclusive schools, and the support needed to thrive. I believe in responsible decision-making, open communication, and collaboration with families, educators, and community members.
If elected, I will use my experience and dedication to help sustain Cambrian's tradition of excellence while planning thoughtfully for the future.

text: Sr. Human Resources Manager

I am running to serve a full term on the Cambrian School District Board of Trustees because I believe every child deserves an education that nurtures both their learning and their well-being. Our students thrive when they feel safe, supported, and seen, and I am committed to ensuring our district continues to prioritize high-quality academics alongside strong mental and emotional health resources.

As an immigrant and the youngest of seven children, I've experienced firsthand how transformative a great education can be. That journey eventually led me to Santa Clara University and brought me to the Bay Area 22 years ago—a community my family is proud to call home.

My wife and I have three children. One currently attends a Cambrian school, and our older two recently graduated from Price Middle School. Our youngest daughter has moderate autism, and through her we've developed a deep, personal commitment to advocating for students with special needs. Living with ADHD myself, I also understand how essential it is for schools to support children facing mental health and neurodiversity challenges.
If elected, my goal is to continue working closely with parents, teachers, and administrators to create thoughtful, sensible policies that help every child feel included, capable, and supported.

text: Program Specialist/Parent

Declining enrollment, aging infrastructure, and several fiscal challenges are facing the Cambrian School District. Letting go of qualified teachers, and school closures are things that negatively impact us all.

The Board's decisions are not just numbers to me─they affect the families we interact with every day. As the parent of three young children, I bring insight into the realities of raising family currently in this community, this economic climate, and these ever changing times.

With over a decade of experience facilitating Parenting Education groups, one of my greatest strengths is listening to the needs of the community with understanding and compassion. Working as a Behavior Therapist across several school districts has given me insight into how districts operate, and how funding cuts can be leveraged to minimize impact on students and teachers. It has also given me practice in advocating for parents and students who may have support needs that differ from the rest of the population.

In this role I will work to give more avenues for community input before decisions are made. I will increase communication with families in the district, and advocate for those who feel their concerns are not being heard.
